#03 / The shop

About the shop

Cutz Unlimited is a barbershop at 4938 S Virginia St in Reno, run by owner and stylist Christian Shaeffer, who specializes in men's haircuts.

The chairs here handle fades, skin fades, tapers and scissor cuts, along with beard trims, head shaves and hot towel shaves. Kids are welcome, and so are women's cuts.

The shop posts its cuts on Instagram at @cutz_unlimited, and every photo on this page comes from there.

Privacy

This site uses no cookies, no tracking and no forms, and it collects nothing about you. Calls and texts go straight to the shop's phone. There is no online booking yet; if a booking link is added, it goes to that booking platform under its own privacy policy.
